summary.name: Easy Indie App
summary.one_liner: easyindie.app is a "Platforms" page that lists self-hosting control panels and platforms (such as Cloudron, CapRover, YunoHost, and Umbrel OS) that aim to make installing and running apps simpler.
use_cases: find an easy way to run apps on a home server
discover alternatives to Heroku or Netlify for self-hosting
set up a personal cloud without deep technical knowledge
summary.what_it_does:
The page is a directory of about two dozen self-hosting platforms and control panels, each with a one-line description. It states that these platforms make it simpler to install, configure, and run apps through a control panel. Listed entries range from PaaS-style tools such as Dokku and Coolify to home-server systems such as CasaOS, umbrelOS, and YunoHost, plus managed hosting services like PikaPods and Elestio. The page itself contains no features, prices, or download details for the individual tools. It is part of the Doorless App Ring and is referenced in the awesome-selfhosted list under External Links.</what_it_does>
